description: Join Lebanon County native, Gracyn Smith, for her April 20 Cocktails for a Cure benefit auction starting at 5:30 pm at the Lebanon Valley Expo. This event includes a dinner and features a live & silent auction. All proceeds help find a cure for Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP), a rare genetic retinal disorder. Gracyn is a college student who was diagnosed with RP at age five. To purchase tickets for the event go towww.crb1.orghttps://www.facebook.com/share/p/iengsQ4LqEmKMJWA/?mibextid=WC7FNe
